May contain spoilers from Sky King's Tomb **Source** [Pathfinder #193: Mantle of Gold](/Sources.aspx?ID=206) pg. 84 **Usage** worn --- Resembling two hands clasped in friendship, this _[diplomat's badge](/Equipment.aspx?ID=431)_ is designed to be woven into the wearer's braided beard. When the wearer befriends others, one of the hands briefly transforms to resemble the befriended creature's own.
**Forming the Bond** The PCs complete the [rite of repatriation](/Rituals.aspx?ID=105).**Advancing the Bond** Solve problems nonviolently. End ancient grudges and heal old wounds, especially those caused by dwarves.
**Minor Gifts** [ancestors' call](/Relics.aspx?ID=123), [linguistic nexus](/Relics.aspx?ID=49), [repository of knowledge](/Relics.aspx?ID=51) (Dwarf Lore, Genealogy Lore, Warfare Lore)
**Major Gifts** [perception filter](/Relics.aspx?ID=52), or increase the diplomat's badge's item bonus to Diplomacy to +2.
name: Uniter of Clans
